position: Section 4.2 of the retention design is a deny list of things no audit record, receipt, quarantine row or aggregate may ever retain. It is enforced by pattern with unknown paths defaulting to hidden, so the next field added upstream defaults to redacted rather than to leaked. Each row below is that table rendered as a field path with the enforcement that actually holds it.

rules.blind: No durable representation may exist at all -- not the value, not a digest. A stable digest of a coordinate is still a stable identifier for that coordinate.
rules.hidden: The value may never appear literally. A comparator may keep an opaque digest of it to say two sides differ.

enforcement.deny_pattern: hear/ingest/reconcile.py VALUE_DENY_PATTERN -- deny beats allow, in one place, for all three modules
enforcement.unknown_default_hidden: not in any allow list, so quoting it is impossible without a contract change and a test

still_quotable.why: A declared facet is part of the question both sides were asked, and a question nobody can read is a comparison nobody can reproduce.
Inclusive versus half-open is the usual way one request becomes two questions.
A record that cannot state its own horizon cannot be reconciled.
A cell above the k floor carries its numbers; its identity is an opaque handle.
